raw_record.summary: Comprehensive GitLab CLI (glab) command reference and workflows for all GitLab operations. Use when working with merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, issues, releases, repositories, authentication, variables, labels, milestones, snippets, or any glab command. Covers 40+ sub-commands including glab mr, glab ci, glab issue, glab repo, glab release, glab variable, and more.
